name: Ilia Topuria
bio: "El Matador". Built on the Brawler base with takedown and kick defense added. He starts patient: single light punches, thrown rarely. The more he's hurt, the more often he throws and the longer his combos get, from 1 punch at full health up to 5 by three-quarter health. After that the combos keep coming faster and every punch hits harder. He sprawls on shots and checks kicks, and answers both with punches. Special move: Aura Farm.
